messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: Severity 3 — single-tenant quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp (dedicated pool: rwd-dedicated-42). Trigger: sudden drop in BLEU/ROUGE-like evals and increased complaint rate. Paging oncall.
alice_oncall: got it, I'm oncall. pulling up traces & recent deploys now.
ben_sre: I see a spike in model mismatch errors and a contemporaneous quantization profile rollout 7m ago. config: qprofile v1.3 -> v1.4 pushed to dedicated pools.
carla_ml: that's the one I rolled out for perf experiments. Any latency/throughput changes? I only intended perf tweaks.
alice_oncall: latency stable, token throughput same. Quality evals on our side show drop vs baseline on Acme prompt set: avg quality score -18%.
eric_infra: confirming dedicated pool rwd-dedicated-42 still on host group g4dn-8x. No infra events. No autoscaler thrash.
carla_ml: okay, initial hypothesis: qprofile v1.4 introduced an aggressive quantization path that reduces precision for a small subset of activation patterns. Looks like Acme's model/usage is hitting that path.
dan_account: Acme just DM'd their CSM, they report hallucinations and truncation on some structured outputs. They said it started "~10m ago".
fae_support: I asked for example prompts and outputs; collecting now. They want ETA and mitigation plan.
alice_oncall: we should isolate tenant to avoid blast radius. options: 1) revert qprofile on that pool -> immediate fallback to v1.3, 2) move Acme to a compatible model variant (fp16/old quant) temporarily, 3) throttle/route to hosted instance.
ben_sre: revert seems fastest. Reverting qprofile on pool takes a 3-5m rolling restart of model processes; token in-flight may be dropped. We can do canary on a subset of machines first.
eric_infra: can do pool-level config rollback. I can run rollback if approved.
carla_ml: before we rollback, can we run an A/B quick eval on a single node to verify v1.3 -> v1.4 delta with Acme's sample? I can run evaluation script if we isolate a node.
alice_oncall: do both. isolate tenant routing so no new requests hit pool nodes chosen for test. then run A/B, if revert restores quality, proceed with full revert.
deploy-bot: Deploy log: qprofile v1.4 rolled to rwd-dedicated-42 at 1749994290 by carla_ml. canary step reported success metric: throughput +6%
ben_sre: safety question — will reverting to v1.3 affect other tenants in the same pool who may have been relying on v1.4 perf improvements? yes, some perf regression expected but quality >= availability.
dan_account: I notified Acme we are investigating; they asked for minimal downtime and a rollback if needed. They're open to a brief maintenance window.
alice_oncall: operational plan:
1) @eric_infra isolate Acme traffic from rwd-dedicated-42 moving it to fallback pool (hosted fallback or rwd-dedicated-21) — estimate 2-4m.
2) @carla_ml run quick A/B on 1 node with Acme sample set -> 5-8m.
3) if quality restored, @eric_infra perform pool-level qprofile rollback to v1.3 with rolling restart -> 5-10m.
4) @alice_oncall verify via eval and customer samples, then notify @dan_account and @fae_support to update Acme.
5) postmortem + follow-up: revert rollout permanently for pools with similar tenant patterns.
carla_ml: running A/B now. command I use:

``` 
python tools/ab_test.py --pool rwd-dedicated-42 --node node-07 --profiles v1.3,v1.4 --tenant-samples data/acme_samples.json
```

alice_oncall: staging test node isolated, please start.
carla_ml: tests running. preliminary outputs look much closer to v1.3. raw diff: 0.82 -> 0.95 quality score for problematic sample set.
eric_infra: starting tenant routing drain: moving Acme -> rwd-dedicated-21 fallback. command:

```
./routerctl move-tenant --tenant acme --from rwd-dedicated-42 --to rwd-dedicated-21 --grace 30s
```

deploy-bot: Router action logged: move-tenant acme -> rwd-dedicated-21 at 1749994378 by eric_infra.
fae_support: Acme just confirmed they see improvement on their end for a few sample requests :thumbsup: they want full rollback if tests confirm.
carla_ml: A/B done. v1.3 matches customer expectation. v1.4 shows the regression reproducible on our samples. attaching snippet:

```
SampleID: A123
v1.3: "Order #552: quantity 3, price OK"
v1.4: "Order #552: qty 3... [missing price]"
```

alice_oncall: we have approval to proceed with rollback. @eric_infra please execute rollback sequence. note: rolling restart will drop in-flight calls — warn CS.
eric_infra: executing rollback now. script:

```
./poolctl set-qprofile --pool rwd-dedicated-42 --profile v1.3 --rolling-restart --parallel 4
```

eric_infra: rollback started. ETA ~8m.
ben_sre: monitoring logs for model errors, KV cache resets. watch for elevated 5xx during restart.
alice_oncall: notify Acme with planned 10m window. @dan_account can you send a short note?
dan_account: sending now: "We're rolling the model config back on your dedicated pool to address quality regressions. Expected brief interruption (~5-10m). We'll follow up with confirmation." Sending via CSM + email.
fae_support: copying them on the status: "We started rollback at 1749994390; monitoring results. Will confirm when stable."
eric_infra: rolling restart progress: 2/8 nodes updated. 0.4% increase in 5xx so far, spiky but within expected. continuing.
carla_ml: re-running evals against pool as nodes finish. early signs quality is returning on nodes that completed rollback.
alice_oncall: status check in 5.
ben_sre: note for post-incident: add tenant-pattern filter to canary policy so big structured-output tenants don't get aggressive qprofiles without manual opt-in.
deploy-bot: Pool config change complete at 1749994448. qprofile v1.3 active on rwd-dedicated-42.
eric_infra: all nodes rolled. all health checks green.
carla_ml: running final quality checks. Acme sample set now at baseline (0.99 vs baseline 1.0). good.
alice_oncall: closing loop: Acme confirmed via CSM that issues resolved. no further complaints in last 15m.
dan_account: customer note sent. they appreciate the quick rollback and asked for a follow-up call next week.
fae_support: I captured example outputs and added to incident thread for the postmortem.
alice_oncall: post-incident actions assigned:
- carla_ml: revert qprofile rollout and add targeted canary rules (PR + deploy)
- ben_sre: add tenant-based canary gating to rollout automation
- eric_infra: add safer rollback automation for dedicated pools
- fae_support & dan_account: coordinate customer follow-up + RCA
Thanks all — marking incident resolved. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved (Severity 3) at 1749994650. Duration ~5m from pager to resolution."
